//: This fork's postgres-pglite is core-only: `pglite/other_extensions` was removed, so the out-of-tree extension bundles (postgis, pg_textsearch, age, pg_hashids, pg_ivm, pgtap, pg_uuidv7, pgvector, pgmq) can no longer be produced and the `wasm:copy-other_extensions` step is gone. The nine `packages/pglite-<ext>` packages are kept in the workspace — the docs site and the REPL still depend on them via `workspace:*` — but they are excluded from `ts:build`, because each one's build copies a `release/*.tar.gz` that no longer exists. Removing the packages outright is a separate change: it also has to gut docs/repl/allExtensions.ts, docs/extensions/extensions.data.ts and the deno test target. In-tree `contrib` extensions are unaffected; they are still built and shipped in packages/pglite/release.

scripts.wasm:build: cd postgres-pglite && PGLITE_VERSION=$(pnpm -s pglite:version) ./build-with-docker.sh && cd .. && pnpm wasm:copy-pglite && pnpm wasm:copy-pgdump && pnpm wasm:copy-initdb
scripts.wasm:build:ci: cd postgres-pglite && PGLITE_VERSION=$(pnpm -s pglite:version) ./build-with-docker.sh -e MAKEFLAGS=-l${PGLITE_BUILD_LOAD:-$(nproc 2>/dev/null || sysctl -n hw.ncpu)} && cd .. && pnpm wasm:copy-pglite && pnpm wasm:copy-pgdump && pnpm wasm:copy-initdb
